name: Ampersand
description: Two bowls and a stroke — the ligature of et, reduced to the geometry it was built from.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16%; top: 10%; width: 44%; height: 44%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 44%; width: 56%; height: 50%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 50%, #000 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 50%, #000 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: scaleX(@pick(1, -1)); transform: scaleX(@pick(1, -1)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
